parent_includes: all regular files recursively except SHA256SUMS and risk-decision-record.yaml
risk_record_circularity_rule: risk-decision-record.yaml references the parent manifest path and its externally verified SHA-256; the parent manifest intentionally excludes the risk record and itself
commit_binding: risk record containing_commit/tree=self means the single Git commit and tree that contain this exact repository-relative path
path_normalization: repository-relative forward slash; no dot or dot-dot segment
entry_format: <sha256 lowercase hexadecimal><two spaces><decimal byte length><two spaces><repository-relative path>
size_binding: decimal byte length is stored in every child and parent entry and verified together with SHA-256
